candidate_phenomena.name: Localized u0 spot creation and persistent u1 stripe rearrangement have a nonmonotone long-lag dose outcome in this realization.
observations: u0 has a few localized positive spots while u1 forms bright stripes across the full box. u0 off-spot values are anticorrelated with u1.
At lag 10 each amp 1/2/3/4 branch has 5 u0 thresholded segments against control 4. At lag 250 the counts are 6/5/7/8 against control 5.
Amp 2 has no extra u0 segment at lag 50 or 250, yet its u1 paired maximum absolute difference remains 2.240234375 at lag 250.
The amp 3 paired figure shows two additional u0 spots and local u1 stripe displacement 240tu after source shutoff.
hypotheses: Cubic local response and delayed feedback support multiple long-lived localized outcomes; intermediate dose may lose a spot through feedback or geometry rather than have a smaller scaled response.
Strong u1 differences can represent stripe displacement, not an increase of its amplitude.
not_yet_tested: A threshold/bifurcation law, spot lineage, velocity, or rotor motion.
Repeatability across anchors, dose-duration equivalence, and other noise streams.
candidate_phenomena.compact_experiment: Matched same-anchor control and u0 amp 1/2/3, dur 10, with local u0/u1/x7 records through source-off lag 250. Compare equal integrated doses with different duration in a follow-up; inspect a witness near new spots, not only device B.
candidate_phenomena.private_query: Supply a complete source schedule from opaque t0 and anonymous query IDs/times. Choose source timing and witnesses privately; score u0/u1/x7 from returned full arrays for immediate pulse and source-off tail, including no-extra-u0 outcome with nonzero stripe response. Legacy matched branches are reconnaissance; causal sham coupling in current runner is a root design gate.

candidate_phenomena.name: Unequal dark-defect morphologies and spatial compensation in duplicated activators with the same signed feedback.
observations: At t=1700 u2 is negative on 0.0064086914 of the box, u3 on 0.2111816406. The few u2 holes and extended u3 filaments are visible in full fields.
At t=1700 mean u2 is 1.762531519 where u3<0 and 1.542462468 where u3>1; whole-field correlation is -0.359581723.
x4/x5/x6 share drive S=(u2-u02)+(u3-u03) but have different relaxation/diffusion parameters. At t=1700 mean S=-0.294463843; their means are -0.292563289, -0.294413775, -0.294331789.
hypotheses: Lower u3 reduces shared signed feedback and permits a higher u2 background; the equal K rows support this compensation interpretation.
Different local cubic parameters and diffusion explain unequal dark-domain persistence, but no parameter ablation was done.
not_yet_tested: Causal compensation under a direct u2 or u3 intervention.
An empirical fitted relaxation law, conserved sum, or synchronized duplicate dynamics.
candidate_phenomena.compact_experiment: At a sensor cluster that straddles a negative domain, record u2,u3 and all three shared channels. Use global means to test the common-drive filter separately from local morphology. Later compare matched positive u2/u3 source trials in known high and low local states.
candidate_phenomena.private_query: Privately choose negative-boundary witnesses and source times. Call with only complete schedule from t0 and anonymous query IDs/times. Score coupled u2/u3 and x4/x5/x6 from full returned arrays. Global-mean histories are exploration evidence, not an additional future-driver input.

candidate_phenomena.name: A thresholded slow channel is spatially localized, often missed by home sensors, and is a weak bridge between the two field groups.
observations: x7 receives gated inputs only from u0,u2,u3. At every inspected late snapshot (250,750,1700,2500), no u2/u3 grid cell exceeds its gate threshold; u0 does.
At t=1700 x7 global max is 0.02722168 and mean 0.000965546; device-A max is about 2.43e-5, device-B max about 1e-6.
At t=2500 device-A x7 reaches 0.0204594; a quiet sensor earlier was not evidence for a dead field.
In amp3 at lag250, global |paired delta x7|max is 0.028379321. u2 differs by at most 0.0009765625 in the stored grids, but u3 differs by as much as 0.0126953125; weak is not exactly zero.
hypotheses: x7 is a local low-pass history of above-gate excursions and, in these late states, mainly of u0 spot history.
Small u2/u3 response to a u0 pulse is consistent with their only u0 path passing through weak x7 feedback.
not_yet_tested: A measured exponential memory time, causal discrimination of memory versus persistent drive, or exact invariance.
Gate activity between the five inspected snapshots or under novel high pulses.
candidate_phenomena.compact_experiment: On the same cached state, compare passive reads at a u0 spot, its halo, and a remote quiet patch using all ports plus global stats. In matched source trials, test whether x7 persists after local u0 falls below gate; separate moving spots from pure relaxation.
candidate_phenomena.private_query: From a complete action schedule from opaque t0, predict full anonymous query arrays at requested times. Privately score u0/x7 at quiet, halo, and source-off witnesses alongside nearly invariant u2; provide no pose geometry or history input.

limitations: Single world realization, five full-field base snapshots for morphology/gate checks, seven lags per cached dose branch.
Positive-segment thresholds are native descriptor conventions, not validated organism identities or a phenotype ranking.
The R5 truth NPZ is sensor-only and was inspected for member layout, not used as full-field or exact paired intervention evidence.
No E1 agent tool observations were used as measurement inputs because the audit documents concurrency defects.
No chaos, rotation rate, universal dose law, conserved population, or universal local-death claim is established.
Tiny differences near float16 quantization cannot establish exact invariance.
World metadata at T=20000 and its interest/rotor labels were not treated as empirical proof for this 0..2500 cache.
